The '''Tyaonon system''' was located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tyaonon [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-18.<ref name="TEA" /> The system shared its name with the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Tyaonon Ranger]]'', which was introduced in "[[The Tyaonon Ranger: A Fast Ship for Star Wars Campaigns]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] source article written by [[Bill Smith]] and published in the [[October]] [[1994]] [[Polyhedron 100|one-hundredth issue]] of the ''[[Polyhedron]]'' magazine for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TyaononRanger">{{PolyhedronCite|100|The Tyaonon Ranger: A Fast Ship for Star Wars Campaigns}}</ref> The article is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>
